attributes.name: Fireproof Wooden Armor
attributes.powers:
Reveal this card to reduce Combat or Fire damage dealt to you by 1, or 2 if the check has the Swashbuckling trait. 

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with light armors, bury it instead.
